parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
ATP is synthesised from ADP and $P_i$ in a phosphorylation reaction.

State the **two** different ways in which this phosphorylation reaction occurs in aerobic respiration.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Coenzymes are important in all four stages of aerobic respiration.

Describe **and** explain the role of the coenzymes NAD and FAD in aerobic respiration.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The enzyme pyruvate dehydrogenase catalyses the link reaction. Pyruvate dehydrogenase is inhibited when the ratio of acetyl coenzyme A to coenzyme A increases.

Suggest the importance of this inhibition to the functioning of the cell.
